subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <optional> header (C++17).
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <optional> header (C++17). Tag types and exception shipped; container itself pending.

symbols.name: optional<T>
symbols.notes: Engaged-or-empty wrapper. C++17 base, C++20 made most members constexpr, C++23 added monadic ops. SHIPPED 2026-08-25. The implementation existed under optional/ from the start; only the umbrella include was missing, so the symbol was unreachable and catalogued as unimplemented.
symbols.failure_reason: Ships at C++11; a C++98 path is tracked work, not an unreachable tier.

symbols.name: nullopt_t
symbols.notes: Tag type for the empty optional state. Ships in re_std/cpp/optional/nullopt.hpp.
symbols.failure_reason: Designated-init-style construction of nullopt requires C++11 brace-or-equal initializers.

symbols.name: nullopt
symbols.notes: constexpr instance of nullopt_t. Std uses inline-variable from C++17; re_std uses static-storage constexpr on C++11+.

symbols.name: bad_optional_access
symbols.notes: Thrown by optional::value() when the optional is empty. Conditional inheritance of std::exception when D_ENV_CPP98_HAS_EXCEPTION; otherwise standalone (mirrors bad_any_cast). Ships in re_std/cpp/optional/bad_optional_access.hpp.

symbols.name: in_place_t
symbols.notes: Tag type for in-place construction. Used by optional, variant, expected. Re_std ships it under <optional> (file re_std/cpp/optional/in_place.hpp); std groups it with <utility>.

symbols.name: in_place
symbols.notes: constexpr instance of in_place_t. Lives in re_std/cpp/optional/in_place.hpp alongside the tag type.

symbols.name: operator<=> (optional)
symbols.notes: C++20 spaceship for optional. Pending re_std::compare. SHIPPED 2026-08-25. The implementation existed under optional/ from the start; only the umbrella include was missing, so the symbol was unreachable and catalogued as unimplemented.
symbols.failure_reason: C++20 LANGUAGE ceiling: operator<=> has no back-port. Its dependency three_way_comparable shipped 2026-08-25, which unblocked it.

symbols.name: hash<optional<T>>
symbols.notes: Specialisation of std::hash for optional. Pending re_std::hash. BACKFILLED 2026-08-25. Disengaged returns a documented non-zero sentinel and is never dereferenced.
symbols.failure_reason: Ships at C++11, which is below the workbook C++98 floor. This is the floor question, not a coverage gap: the module is currently gated on C++11 and has no C++98 path yet. That is tracked work, not an unreachable tier -- RE_STD_AGENT_README states re_std compiles on C++98 through C++26, and its known-issues table logs blanket C++11 gating (any.hpp) as planned work. See the OPEN tier-floor item.
